title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Sapien is working with an established engineering manufacturer specialising in laboratory and process equipment, automated packaging machinery and production lines to recruit an Internal Sales Executive based in Haywards Heath.

We're looking for an ambitious, energetic individual who enjoys building relationships, speaking with people and turning opportunities into sales. This role would suit someone currently working in customer service, customer success, a call centre or an internal sales environment who is looking to take the next step in their career.

You'll need to be confident picking up the phone, speaking to new people, following up leads and proactively chasing business. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, thrives on building relationships and is motivated to turn potential opportunities into sales rather than simply waiting for enquiries to come in.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly to incoming sales enquiries and new leads, ensuring opportunities are followed up effectively.
- Proactively contact prospective customers by telephone and email to qualify leads and identify new sales opportunities.
- Prepare and issue quotations, working closely with the Field Sales team to ensure customers receive accurate and timely information.
- Follow up on outstanding quotations and proposals issued by the Field Sales team to help convert opportunities into orders.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with prospective and existing customers.
- Support the Field Sales team with customer communications, sales administration and account management.
- Nurture leads and maintain regular contact with potential customers throughout the sales process.
- Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, enquiries, quotations and sales opportunities.
- Work towards agreed sales activity targets and contribute to the wider team's performance.

Key Requirements
- Experience in a customer-facing role where communication and relationship-building are central to the job.
- A confident telephone manner and a willingness to make outbound calls and follow up with prospective customers.
- Ambition, energy and a genuine desire to succeed in a sales environment.
- A proactive and resilient attitude, with the confidence to chase opportunities and convert conversations into business.
- The ability to build rapport with a wide range of customers.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple enquiries and follow-ups.
- A target-driven mindset, with the motivation to achieve results and continually improve.
- The ability to work collaboratively within a sales team while taking ownership of individual responsibilities.

Location & Working Arrangements
- Location: Haywards Heath.
- Working arrangement: Primarily office-based, with hybrid working negotiable.
- Office attendance: Regular attendance at the Haywards Heath office is expected.
- Hours: 35 hours per week, with flexibility where required to meet business needs.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary negotiable, depending on experience.
- 8% employer pension contribution.
- Annual performance-related bonus.
- Annual salary review.
- 24 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays and a Christmas shutdown.
- Company phone.
- Optional private medical cover.
- Death-in-service benefit.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrable experience in a sales or account management role, have a proven track record of managing existing accounts and winning new business as well as experience using CRM systems and managing accurate sales records. You will possess excellent customer service skills, be able to read technical drawings and communicate requirements clearly and actively be able to identify solutions for customers and internal teams.

As a Sales and Account Executive you will be the primary commercial contact for existing customers as well as new business prospects, building strong relationships, understanding customers needs and working with internal teams to ensure strong levels of customer service and growth are achieved.

The Ideal candidate will possess the following skills and qualities:
- Demonstrable experience in a sales or account management role, ideally within manufacturing, precision engineering or similar
- Proven track record of managing existing accounts and winning new business
- Familiarity with B2 B customer interactions, ideally including OEMs and subcontract supplies/customers
- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate sales records
- Ability to build trust and maintain long-term client relationships
- Understanding pricing, margins and business profitability
- Ability to read drawings, understand manufacturing processes and communicate technical requirements clearly
- Be able to present to customers, negotiate terms and close deals
- Possess strong organisational and time management
- Ability to proactively identify solutions for customers and internal teams
- Be competent in MS Office including teams

Your duties as a Sales and Account Executive will be:
- Serve as the main point of contact for existing customers, fostering strong relationships and high customer satisfaction
- Understand customer operations and manufacturing requirements to help them solve issues with the company s capabilities
- Coordinate internally with scheduling, production and quality teams to ensure timely fulfilment and service excellence
- Identify, research and engage potential new customers suitable for the company s capabilities
- Evaluate the business opportunities with new leads, prepare and present quotations and proposals to win new business
- Attend industry events, exhibitions and networking opportunities to represent the company and build the portfolio of customers
- Setting key targets with the site manager and reviewing on a monthly/quarterly and annual basis
- Working with site manager and production teams to convert enquiries into orders
- Maintaining/help developing accurate CRM records and track progress against sales targets

- Responding promptly to all technical and commercial enquiries
- Following up on quotes, manage negotiations and help close business

£30,000 - £40,000 per annum (plus commission/bonus)

Monday Friday, 38 hour per week

Full Time, Permanent

St Leonards on Sea, East Sussex
